rows.title: A/A run, same system as baseline and subject, 5+ sessions
rows.threshold: CI contains 1 in >= 90% of cells and |ratio-1| <= 10%
rows.how: bash readiness/run.sh --stage lib-aa

rows.title: Injected known regression is caught by the gate
rows.threshold: fpbench gate exits non-zero
rows.how: bash readiness/run.sh --stage selftest

rows.title: Loader calibration against a null stack at the highest planned rate
rows.threshold: loader <= 70% of one core, >= 98% completion
rows.how: bash readiness/run.sh --stage calibrate   (run on the benchmark host, loader pinned)

rows.title: Target workload sustained within the SLO (open loop)
rows.threshold: highest sustainable customer-to-cash rate >= target rate with p99 <= SLO, claim-grade journey report
rows.how: bash readiness/run.sh --stage e2e-perf   (needs SLO_P99_S and TARGET_RATE)

rows.title: Claim-grade engine comparison vs Hot Chocolate + EF
rows.threshold: claim grade YES, 5+ sessions, equivalent responses, telemetry, disclosed environment; equal-work controls added
rows.how: bash readiness/run.sh --stage lib   (equal-work controls: tuned EF, raw SQL floor, EF batch tool are NOT built yet)

rows.title: Knee search and overload behaviour
rows.threshold: graceful degradation; recovery within the agreed time
rows.how: bash readiness/run.sh --stage e2e-perf --overload   (needs SLO_P99_S; MAX_RECOVERY_S default 120). Staged cell: normal -> 2x top rate -> normal; recovery time measured per 10 s window (verified on mock)

rows.title: Fault matrix: hard-kill each service singly and in pairs
rows.threshold: zero invariant violations in every cell
rows.how: bash readiness/run.sh --stage faults

rows.title: Network latency and partition between services
rows.threshold: zero invariant violations in every cell
rows.how: bash readiness/run.sh --stage faults   (docker network disconnect/connect --alias for partitions, tc netem via nicolaka/netshoot for latency; no Toxiproxy needed)

rows.title: Crash mid-transaction and mid-workflow
rows.threshold: zero invariant violations in every cell
rows.how: bash readiness/run.sh --stage faults

rows.title: Outbox drain time after outage
rows.threshold: within the agreed time at 5 journeys/s
rows.how: bash readiness/run.sh --stage faults   (MAX_DRAIN_S)

rows.title: Soak at 60% of capacity, 24 h minimum
rows.threshold: RSS growth <= 5%, p99 drift <= 10%, failures <= 1%
rows.how: SOAK_RATE=<60% of sustainable> bash readiness/run.sh --stage soak

rows.title: Tenant isolation under concurrent multi-tenant load
rows.threshold: 0 leaks over >= 1000 journeys with positive controls
rows.how: bash readiness/run.sh --stage tenant

rows.title: Authorization parity across GraphQL, MCP and REST with a real policy
rows.threshold: identical decisions on the shared vector set
rows.how: bash readiness/run.sh --stage existing-suites   (runs the existing security/gateway/MCP suites; a cross-surface parity test against the e2e stack is NOT written yet)

rows.title: Approval tokens and warrants: replay, tamper, expiry, Redis down
rows.threshold: all rejected; fail closed
rows.how: bash readiness/run.sh --stage existing-suites   (existing replay/warrant tests; Redis-down against the live stack not scripted)

rows.title: Agent path with a real model: prompt injection, forged approvals
rows.threshold: no mutation without host-resolved approval
rows.how: needs a model key and an attack corpus: run, then python3 -m fpbench evidence R15 pass|fail --dir <ev> --detail <summary> --artifact <report>

rows.title: Bearer-token hardening: missing, garbage, bad-signature, alg=none and edited-payload tokens rejected
rows.threshold: 401/403 on every attempt, valid token accepted (positive control), on the protected CRM and ERP endpoints
rows.how: bash readiness/run.sh --stage auth-attack   (AUTH_ENDPOINTS = space-separated protected GET URLs)

rows.title: Dependency, SBOM and secret scans; independent review
rows.threshold: no unresolved high/critical findings
rows.how: bash readiness/run.sh --stage scans   (third-party review is recorded manually as IND2)

rows.title: Graceful restart under load
rows.threshold: error rate < 0.1% during the restart (single instance: measures the outage window; true rolling deploy needs 2+ replicas)
rows.how: bash readiness/run.sh --stage ops

rows.title: Migrations on a populated database
rows.threshold: no data loss on re-run/restart; rollback tested
rows.how: bash readiness/run.sh --stage ops   (restart-with-data automated; rollback is manual)

rows.title: Backup and restore drill
rows.threshold: restore time and data loss within RTO/RPO
rows.how: bash readiness/run.sh --stage ops   (RTO_S, RPO_S)

rows.title: Version upgrade with compatibility tests
rows.threshold: no breaking API change without a documented policy
rows.how: run the readiness suite at FOUNDGINE_REF=<old> and <new>, compare verdicts; then record

rows.title: Telemetry usable in an incident
rows.threshold: on-call finds an injected fault within the agreed time
rows.how: inject a fault from configs/e2e-fault-matrix.json blind; time the diagnosis; record
